'''Corellia Control''' was the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] space traffic control organization for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] after they conquered it during the early stages of the [[Battle of Corellia]]. Corellia Control put [[Cipher Nine]] in contact with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Trage]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
